description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguage entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing employee language skills with properties such as fluency, competency, and comments. It includes ORM mappings and validation logic for fluency and competency levels.
external_methods: Doctrine ORM annotations such as @ORM	able

classes.name: EmployeeLanguage
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's language skill with associated properties such as fluency, competency, and comments. Implements ORM mappings and validation.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this language skill record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee object associated with this language skill record.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the Language object associated with this employee language.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the Language object for this employee language record.

methods.name: getFluency
methods.description: Returns the fluency level for this language, as an integer corresponding to predefined options.

methods.name: setFluency
methods.description: Sets the fluency level, validating against allowed values.

methods.name: getCompetency
methods.description: Returns the competency level for this language, or null if not set.

methods.name: setCompetency
methods.description: Sets the competency level, validating against allowed values.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the optional comment about this language skill.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets an optional comment for this language skill.
